bengal.title: The History of Florence, and of the affairs of Italy, from the earliest times to the death of Lorenzo the Magnificent; together with The Prince and various historical tracts. By Niccolo Machiavelli. A New Translation. London: Bell & Daldy, York Street, Covent Garden. 1872.

florence.reason: All three are the same work and the same translation — Bohn's Standard Library 'A New Translation' of Machiavelli's History of Florence and of the Affairs of Italy ... together with The Prince and Various Historical Tracts (identical long title, same translator, same York Street Covent Garden imprint line). They are NOT different volumes and NOT different books: 14051 is the 1847 first Bohn printing; bengal (dli.bengal.10689.19369) is the 1872 Bell & Daldy reprint of the same translation; 02746 (dli.ministry.02746) is another Henry G. Bohn printing of the same translation whose title-page year is garbled in OCR ('V.D.20'), so its exact year cannot be fixed from this scan — but the imprint and contents (identical Book I contents list) identify it as the same Bohn's Standard Library text. Hence same work, different printings/editions across the three scans.
